cadet.scenario.jezero.goal.primary: Do enough science, keep everything working, and get everyone home safe.
cadet.scenario.jezero.goal.stretch: Pick every plant tray before you're done.
cadet.scenario.firstLight.goal.primary: Keep everyone alive through the whole mission.
cadet.scenario.theLongNight.goal.primary: Keep everyone alive through all three long nights.
cadet.crisis.apollo13.goal.primary: Keep Lovell, Swigert, and Haise alive until the adapter is built.
cadet.crisis.apollo13.goal.stretch: Build the adapter without losing any onboard systems.
cadet.crisis.spe1972.goal.primary: Protect all 3 astronauts from lethal solar radiation until the storm passes.
cadet.crisis.spe1972.goal.stretch: Survive the solar storm without losing any electronics or life support systems.
cadet.crisis.mirFire.goal.primary: Extinguish the oxygen generator fire and keep all 6 cosmonauts and astronauts alive.
cadet.crisis.mirFire.goal.stretch: Suppress the fire and clear the toxic smoke without losing power distribution.

specialist.scenario.jezero.goal.primary: Meet the science target, keep every system running, and bring the whole crew home.
specialist.scenario.jezero.goal.stretch: Harvest every crop tray before the mission ends.
specialist.scenario.firstLight.goal.primary: Survive the full night-day-night cycle with the whole crew alive.
specialist.scenario.firstLight.goal.stretch: End the mission with no system left failed.
specialist.scenario.theLongNight.goal.primary: Survive all three lunar nights with the whole crew alive.
specialist.scenario.theLongNight.goal.stretch: End the mission with no system left failed.
specialist.crisis.apollo13.goal.primary: Prevent toxic hypercapnia and sustain 3 crew aboard LM Aquarius.
specialist.crisis.apollo13.goal.stretch: Maintain cabin ppCO2 below toxic limit and leave all systems operational.
specialist.crisis.spe1972.goal.primary: Shelter the crew to keep per-event acute radiation dose below 250 mSv.
specialist.crisis.spe1972.goal.stretch: Prevent acute radiation sickness with zero failed systems at event completion.
specialist.crisis.mirFire.goal.primary: Suppress the Kvant-1 fire within 14 minutes and prevent crew asphyxiation.
specialist.crisis.mirFire.goal.stretch: Extinguish the fire and restore station air quality with all systems operational.

commander.scenario.jezero.goal.primary: science.points >= scenarioTargetPoints, every system operational, full crew survival (engine/goals.ts's missionGoalsMet).
commander.scenario.jezero.goal.stretch: All crop trays harvested at least once (harvestAllCropTrays).
commander.scenario.firstLight.goal.primary: Full mission duration elapsed, zero crew loss (surviveFullDurationNoLoss).
commander.scenario.firstLight.goal.stretch: No system in a failed state at mission end (noSystemLeftFailed).
commander.scenario.theLongNight.goal.primary: Full mission duration elapsed, zero crew loss (surviveFullDurationNoLoss).
commander.scenario.theLongNight.goal.stretch: No system in a failed state at mission end (noSystemLeftFailed).
commander.crisis.apollo13.goal.primary: Full crisis elapsed duration survived with zero crew loss (surviveFullDurationNoLoss).
commander.crisis.apollo13.goal.stretch: No systems in a failed state at crisis end (noSystemLeftFailed).
commander.crisis.spe1972.goal.primary: Full SPE crisis duration survived with zero crew loss (surviveFullDurationNoLoss).
commander.crisis.spe1972.goal.stretch: No systems in a failed state at crisis end (noSystemLeftFailed).
commander.crisis.mirFire.goal.primary: Full Mir fire crisis duration survived with zero crew loss (surviveFullDurationNoLoss).
commander.crisis.mirFire.goal.stretch: No systems in a failed state at crisis end (noSystemLeftFailed).
